title_patterns_that_work: Use parenthetical curiosity hooks like '(The Truth)' or '(I Checked)'
Target popular e-commerce platforms and apps (e.g., DHgate, Zocdoc, WeWard)
Clearly format as a Short with '#Shorts' as it drives significantly higher discovery compared to long-form content
title_patterns_to_avoid: Long-form review formats without strong upfront urgency
Generic titles lacking a specific platform or app name
notes: Shorts consistently outperform long-form videos significantly in terms of views, with topics focusing on consumer safety and legitimacy (e.g., DHgate, WeWard, Zocdoc) driving the best engagement.
